title: BSM Combined Dataset (Augmented)
subtitle: Beach Sand Minerals with paper augmentation + translation
description: Combined dataset for D-ResNet paper reproduction. Original 367 images augmented with horizontal flip, 6 rotations (0,30,45,90,180,270), and pixel translation (±15%). Resized to 224x224, ImageNet normalized. 1464 total images, 6 classes, 244 per class.
